entries.text: Parquet conversion always uses one writer (PyArrow) and reads up to two chunk files at once, so output no longer depends on whether DuckDB is installed or how much memory it can use. TPC-H conversion from default chunked zstd input takes 3.0 s at SF 1 and 35.8 s at SF 10, down from 9.1 s and 95.2 s, with unchanged output bytes. Row groups hold the configured row_group_size (122,880 by default; the last holds the remainder) and NOT NULL columns stay required. Cached Parquet written by the retired DuckDB path is regenerated on the next Parquet run.

Format conversion honours the CSV null marker recorded in the data manifest, as the platform loaders do. ClickBench now converts to Parquet: empty strings in its NOT NULL text columns stay empty strings instead of failing with "declared non-nullable but contains nulls".
